title: Uninstall a skill by slug
notes: Irreversible — removes both the skill-catalog index row and the vendored package copy (SKILL.md, scripts/, references/, assets/). Reinstalling from the original source package is the only way to bring it back.

title: Uninstall a skill by catalog row ID (fallback)
notes: Use only when the slug is unknown — get it from skill_list otherwise.
